author: Riilo
body:
I don't give 7 shits if this isn't the right area. 

Steven is always on teamspeak, and I find him annoying. I have muted steven and blocked him on over 90 identities (Im not even exaggerating. Stevem constantly goes on new identities to bypass me muting him and ITS JUST SO FUCKING ANNOYING. I'm so done with him and this counts as harassment.

https://gyazo.com/f2d399a46919663730957f82b1ee4737
Thats an image of him doing it. I have already spoke to Michael about the situation when he was staff and he got a warning for it. Please can't he just be tempbanned or some shit.
